explication: Sampler is a terminal application for running configured shell commands at intervals and visualizing their output. The principal workflow is YAML configuration → configured samplers and display components → sampled command output → terminal rendering; users can also interactively rearrange components and save changed positions. Distinct display stages include run charts, sparklines, bar charts, gauges, textboxes, and ASCII art. Conditional triggers provide alert and action capabilities. The architecture follows the visible startup and event-handling code; several links to unsampled internals are documented by the README rather than verified from implementation excerpts.
